name: Extra Nanite Surge
body:
You can use your nanite surge ability more often.

Prerequisite: Android, nanite surge racial trait.

Benefit: You can use your nanite surge one additional time per day.

Special: You can take this feat more than once. Its effects stack, granting you an additional daily use of your nanite surge each time you take it.
